description: Initialize Git repository and create monorepo structure with pnpm workspaces, Turborepo, and shared configuration packages (ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript). This feature establishes the foundational tooling that all other features depend on.
steps: Initialize Git repository with `git init` if not already initialized
Create pnpm-workspace.yaml defining workspace pattern: apps/*, packages/*

Create root package.json with workspace:* protocol for internal dependencies; scripts for dev, build, test, lint, type-check, format, format:check; devDependencies: turbo, typescript, prettier, eslint, husky, lint-staged, @commitlint/cli, @commitlint/config-conventional
Create turbo.json with pipelines for dev, build, test, lint, type-check, format, format:check; configure caching and dependencies between tasks
Create packages/config/package.json with shared config dependencies (@typescript-eslint/parser, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-react-hooks)
Create packages/config/tsconfig.base.json with strict: true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true, module: ESNext, moduleResolution: bundler, target: ES2022
Create packages/config/eslint.config.js (flat config) with TypeScript + React rules, no-console rule for production, no-any without comment
Create packages/config/.prettierrc.json with 2-space indent, semi: true, singleQuote: true, trailingComma: 'es5'
Create root tsconfig.json extending packages/config/tsconfig.base.json with references to all workspace packages
Create .gitignore with node_modules/, dist/, build/, .turbo/, .env, .DS_Store, coverage/, *.log
Run `npx husky install` to initialize Git hooks
acceptance_criteria: pnpm-workspace.yaml correctly defines apps/* and packages/* patterns
Root package.json has all required scripts and devDependencies
turbo.json defines all required pipelines with correct dependency chains
packages/config exports working ESLint, Prettier, and TypeScript configs
Git hooks are installed and executable
Attempting a commit with invalid conventional commit format is rejected
verification: Run `pnpm install` and confirm no errors
Run `pnpm lint` (should pass with no files yet)
Test commit hook: `git add .` then `git commit -m 'bad message'` should fail; `git commit -m 'chore: test'` should succeed
findings: Monorepo structure successfully initialized. Git hooks installed and working correctly on Windows. ESLint flat config simplified to work with installed packages (TypeScript and React plugins will be configured when actual apps are created in later features). All lint-staged and commitlint hooks functioning as expected. Note: Prettier configured for LF line endings, but Git will handle CRLF conversion on Windows automatically.
